title: Woman in Angel Costume Sobs During DUI Arrest After Halloween Party
description:
On the night before Halloween, Florida police pull over a woman dressed in an angel costume — complete with fake blood. North Port officers ask Naomi Furrer to perform a set of sobriety tests after smelling alcohol in the car, observing slurred speech and a bottle of fireball whiskey in the back seat. What happened next had Naomi, a Switzerland citizen, crying and begging officers to let her go free.

From high-speed chases to DUI arrests, Law&Crime BodyCam delivers the most shocking police encounters straight from the source. Subscribe now and catch the action: @lawandcrimebodycam
